name: balanced
description: Representative cross-section of civic professions with varied reasoning approaches.

personas.traits: Values chronological consistency and verifiable physical corroboration.
Scrutinizes documentary records and cross-examines financial timelines.
Focuses on spatial feasibility, line of sight, and witness vantage points.
Strict adherence to admitted exhibits without speculative extrapolation.
Assesses behavioral plausibility and everyday human motivations.
Challenges untested assertions and tests for underlying bias or motive.
Constructs logical dependency trees between timeline events and evidence.
